How do I activate my license key?

Enter your XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX key in the activation field above and tap "Activate License". Each key grants timed access to the Revo Fixer platform based on its package (1h / 2h / 4h / 8h / 1 Day). A single key can be used on up to 3 devices — exceeding that limit requires a reset by @RevoAgent.

What packages are available and what do they cost?

Five real plans sourced live from the platform: 1 Hour (₹2,000), 2 Hours (₹3,750 — most popular), 4 Hours (₹7,550), 8 Hours (₹15,000) and 1 Day (₹40,000). Every plan includes priority queue access; longer plans add premium/VIP support and extended coverage. Active discounts apply automatically when the admin enables them.

Which payment methods are supported?

Three real methods: UPI (Google Pay / PhonePe / Paytm to the live UPI ID), Bkash (Personal agent number), and USDT (crypto wallet transfer). Send the exact amount, take a screenshot, and forward it to @RevoAgent along with your desired package. Minimum deposit is ₹3,000.

How does USDT pricing work?

The live USDT→INR rate is ₹94.14 per 1 USDT (sourced from appSettings). Use the converter above to compute exact amounts. For example, the minimum deposit of ₹3,000 is approximately 31.87 USDT. Send only USDT (TRC-20) to the wallet shown in the Payments section.

Can I transfer my wallet balance to a betting site?

Wallet-to-betting transfers are currently ACTIVE. The minimum transfer amount is ₹6,000. Submit a transfer request with your betting link and username; the admin processes it manually. Status updates appear in your dashboard activity log.

My key says 'reset_required' — what do I do?

This means your key was used on more than 3 devices and has been locked for security. Contact @RevoAgent on Telegram with your key and proof of purchase to request a manual reset. Banned keys cannot be reinstated — they are permanently blocked for terms violations.

What is the refund policy?

License keys are non-refundable once activated and bound to a device. If your key fails verification or was never used, contact support within 24 hours with your transaction screenshot for review. Refunds for approved-but-unclaimed packages are at the admin's discretion and processed via the original payment method.

How do I reach support?

The fastest channel is Telegram — join the official channel or DM @RevoAgent directly. For payment or account issues, email support@revofixer.com with your license key and transaction ID. Support is available 24/7 for premium package holders (8h / 1 Day plans).

1. License Key Terms

A Revo Fixer license key grants timed, non-transferable access to the platform for the duration specified by its package (1h / 2h / 4h / 8h / 1 Day). Keys are sold as one-time purchases and are bound to the first device that activates them.

Each key may be used on up to 3 devices. Exceeding this limit automatically marks the key as reset_required and locks it pending admin review.
Banned keys (status: banned) are permanently revoked for terms violations and cannot be reinstated.
Keys are validated in real-time against the live platform database. Tampering, sharing, or reselling keys is prohibited.
The platform reserves the right to revoke any key engaged in abuse, fraud, or unauthorized redistribution.
2. Payments & Pricing

All prices are sourced live from the platform and displayed in Indian Rupees (₹). The current 5 plans and their real prices are shown in the Packages section above.

Accepted methods: UPI, Bkash, and USDT (TRC-20) to the live destinations shown in the Payment Methods section.
Minimum deposit is ₹3,000 (≈ 31.87 USDT at the live rate of ₹94.14/USDT).
